subject: Animation
title: Jason and the Argonauts: The Skeleton Fight
description: One-minute skill: Jason and the Argonauts: The Skeleton Fight.

hook.text: In 1963, Harryhausen animated seven skeleton warriors fighting three live actors simultaneously.

buildup.text: Each skeleton had to be animated separately, frame by frame, while matching the actors' pre-filmed movements.

discovery.text: The scene took Harryhausen over four months to complete. It lasts just four minutes on screen.

twist.text: No computer assisted the work. Every skeleton's movement was calculated by hand and eye alone.

climax.text: The skeleton fight is widely considered the greatest stop-motion sequence ever filmed.

punchline.text: Four months of work became four minutes of legend.

quiz.question: How long did the famous skeleton fight scene in Jason and the Argonauts take to animate?
options: Over four months for approximately four minutes of screen time
